newsitem.title: USA: Lehman to sell One Times Square - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Lehman to sell One Times Square - NYT.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc is selling the landmark One Times Square for about $110 million, reaping a hefty profit just two years after it bought it for $27.5 million, the New York Times said.

In Thursday's edition, the Times said Lehman has signed a contact to sell the 22-storey building -- the longtime site of the New Year's Eve ball drop -- to the Jamestown group, a German investment firm.

"I can confirm that we have a contract," said Stephen Zoukis, a managing partner at Jamestown, which has an office in Atlanta, "but since we haven't closed, I can't say anything else about that transaction."

Jamestown would be paying $1,000 per square foot for the building. But the landmark building in the heart of Times Square commands millions of dollars in rental revenue from advertising displayed prominently on its facade.
